title: Map each artifact name to its contract file path with the fixed formula

facts.note: Any text (plan, wagon, acceptance, doc, code, tooling, config) that names an artifact or its contract file path.
Contract files live under contracts/; the mapping may be written or referenced in any file (planner docs, code, tooling), so the referencing side is not restricted to a document type.

values: artifact name mapped to a contract file path
contract file path added, moved or referenced for an artifact
facts.note: Needs a diff observer that extracts artifact names (any shape, e.g. theme:aspect.variant or theme:seg1:seg2:aspect.variant) and contract paths and pairs them.

fires: An artifact with a short name such as theme:aspect.variant is mapped to its contract file (e.g. commons:identifiers.uuid).
An artifact with several segments (theme:seg1:seg2:aspect.variant) is mapped to its contract file.
A plan, wagon, acceptance or other doc references the contract file of a named artifact.
Code, a script or tooling computes or hard-codes the contract file path for an artifact name.
A contract file is added or moved under contracts/ for an artifact.
An artifact name is renamed and its contract file path must follow.
doesNotFire: Text or code that never maps an artifact name to a contract file path (e.g. pure behavioral acceptance prose).
Files that are not contract files and are not derived from an artifact name.

given: An artifact name (theme, optional segments, final segment, e.g. theme:seg1:seg2:aspect.variant or theme:aspect.variant) is mapped to a contract file path, in any document, code or tooling.
when: You write, reference or compute the contract file path for that artifact.
then: Derive the path deterministically: contracts/ + theme and each segment as directories, the final segment as the filename, with the .schema.json extension (theme:seg1:seg2:aspect.variant -> contracts/theme/seg1/seg2/aspect/variant.schema.json).
prefer: Split the artifact name on ':' and '.' and turn every part except the last into a directory under contracts/; the last part becomes <part>.schema.json.
avoid: Hand-picked or flattened paths that do not mirror every name segment (e.g. collapsing segments into one filename).
Keeping ':' or '.' from the artifact name in the file path, or using an extension other than .schema.json.
Renaming an artifact without moving the referenced contract path to match.
why: The artifact-name -> file-path transform is deterministic, so any tool or reader can locate a contract from its name alone; a path that diverges breaks that lookup.
evidence: For each artifact name, applying the formula yields exactly the referenced or computed contract file path.
verifier_detail: Transform: replace ':' and '.' separators in the artifact name with '/', prefix 'contracts/', append '.schema.json'. Formula: theme:seg1:seg2:aspect.variant -> contracts/theme/seg1/seg2/aspect/variant.schema.json. Works for any number of segments, including none (theme:aspect.variant).
Term file_mapping: the deterministic artifact-name -> file-path transform.
